desc.en: This impressive 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom, 4 toilet Villa situated in a quiet, relaxed urbanization has recently benefited from a renovation including the outside of the Villa. To the left of the living area, there is a modern fitted kitchen with marble worktops. The house can be offered fully furnished, including all white goods if required at no extra cost. The property has a complete alarm and security system inside and out. The garden has a full irrigation system, easily operated by a timer, and contains mature shrubs and trees, although it remains low maintenance with artificial grass and many paved areas. The fishpond has an easy-to-operate filtration system via its attractive waterfall. Throughout the garden in all areas are outdoor electric power sockets for convenience. The large workshop and sheds all have lighting and electricity, there is also a large driveway which easily houses 2 cars. desc.es: Esta impresionante villa de 3 dormitorios, 3 baños y 4 aseos situada en una urbanización tranquila y relajada se ha beneficiado recientemente de una renovación que incluye el exterior de la villa. La casa se puede ofrecer completamente amueblada, incluidos todos los electrodomésticos si es necesario sin costo adicional. La piscina privada tiene luces que cambian de color, al igual que la gran casa de verano que está junto a la piscina y contiene electricidad completa para una excelente vida al aire libre. Todo el jardín se ilumina por la noche con la opción de luces que cambian de color o de un solo color.
